storyCards.headline: Sugar Sugar: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Archies's "Sugar Sugar" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "The Archies Greatest Hits" (1970) — not the song's original release year.

Album: The Archies Greatest Hits (1970).

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
